sprints.title: Mechanisms, evidence and power
sprints.brief: When does a face match become a defensible decision?
sprints.new_learning: Data versus information, inputs/process/outputs, thresholds, false matches and evidence versus assertion.
sprints.product: A school-entry face-matching analysis with a small source synthesis and independent changed-threshold response.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: Age assurance and policy judgment
sprints.brief: How can a platform protect young users while limiting new data and access costs?
sprints.new_learning: Verification, estimation and inference; policy objectives; impact versus implication; conditional judgment.
sprints.product: An age-assurance recommendation supported by mechanism comparison, source synthesis and changed-context transfer.
sprints.release_status: Student workbook available; timed assessments released separately by teacher

sprints.title: Data, algorithms and recommendation
sprints.brief: Who benefits when a feed optimizes attention?
sprints.new_learning: Data lifecycle, databases, algorithm components, ranking, feedback loops, scale and algorithmic dilemmas.
sprints.product: Paper recommender, theme synthesis and an independently redesigned ranking rule.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: Computers, networks and privacy
sprints.brief: How can a technical failure become a public-service failure?
sprints.new_learning: Computer components, evolution, protocols, routing, web services, security and recovery trade-offs.
sprints.product: Network simulation, a source-based outage explanation and changed-service transfer.
sprints.release_status: Published student workbook; timed assessment Forms released separately

sprints.title: AI, robots and human oversight
sprints.brief: When should a human rely on an automated recommendation or action?
sprints.new_learning: AI types and development, learning versus inference, neural-network models, sensor/action loops and oversight.
sprints.product: Classifier/robot simulation, source synthesis and a justified oversight recommendation.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: Media, culture and political participation
sprints.brief: Who should decide what remains visible on a platform?
sprints.new_learning: Media forms/convergence, immersive media, source authenticity, policy enforcement and synthesis by theme.
sprints.product: Moderation simulation, theme-based synthesis and changed-context policy analysis.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: Infrastructure, environment and inequality
sprints.brief: Under what conditions should a community support a new digital infrastructure project?
sprints.new_learning: Energy/resource estimates, uncertainty, lifecycle impacts, geography, unequal access and scale.
sprints.product: Transparent estimate, source synthesis and independent infrastructure recommendation.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: Practice inquiry and evidence communication
sprints.brief: What makes a digital-society question answerable with real evidence?
sprints.new_learning: Specific inquiry focus, case boundaries, source feasibility, balanced perspectives and visual evidence.
sprints.product: A short inquiry proposal, contrasting-source synthesis and feasibility defence.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: Cumulative repair and Paper 1 diagnostic
sprints.brief: Can you build the complete reasoning chain without a sentence scaffold?
sprints.new_learning: Selecting the right mechanism and evidence across cases, diagnosing weak links and transferring after feedback.
sprints.product: One changed-case response, one theme synthesis and a defended parallel repair.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: Unfamiliar sources and Paper 2 diagnostic
sprints.brief: Can you adapt the reasoning to a system and context you have not practised together?
sprints.new_learning: Rapid mechanism selection, source conflict, health/human-knowledge contexts and timed argument organization.
sprints.product: Two complementary timed samples: source synthesis and changed-scenario analysis, followed by a short defence.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: IA inquiry and research
sprints.brief: What evidence can sustain your own focused inquiry?
sprints.new_learning: Sustained individual research, essential-source selection, counter-evidence and a feasible analytical structure.
sprints.product: IA research checkpoint within the single inquiry project; do not create a second assessed IA.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: IA analysis and production
sprints.brief: How will your evidence support an analytical multimedia explanation?
sprints.new_learning: Sustained causal analysis, implications, researched future developments and purposeful multimedia communication.
sprints.product: The inquiry draft and process evidence; formative checkpoints belong to the same IA.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: IA completion and exam transfer
sprints.brief: Can you finish an authentic inquiry and then return to unfamiliar exam reasoning?
sprints.new_learning: Independent revision, final technical checks, authenticity and separating inquiry ownership from exam rehearsal.
sprints.product: Final inquiry submission package and authenticity record; one project, not three IA grades.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: Paper 1 performance and Mock B
sprints.brief: Can you explain, apply and evaluate within the structure and time of Paper 1?
sprints.new_learning: Question selection, command terms, concise technical explanation and sustained evaluation under exam conditions.
sprints.product: One complete Paper 1 Mock A and a short parallel repair, with sampled reasoning defence.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: Paper 2 performance and Mock B
sprints.brief: Can you integrate sources into one argument under timed conditions?
sprints.new_learning: Source relationships, purpose/method limits, thematic organization and precise use of own knowledge.
sprints.product: One complete Paper 2 Mock A; April 20 is rehearsal, not a second mock.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production

sprints.title: Readiness and targeted final repair
sprints.brief: Is independent performance reliable across fresh papers?
sprints.new_learning: Independent repair, self-monitoring and focused final revision.
sprints.product: Parallel repair samples and a justified final study plan.
sprints.release_status: Overview only; new workbook in production
